reproduction.rationale: The legacy historical outcome remains unresolved and protocol remains null. The additive paired retinal interface is an unexecuted fresh within-cell comparison; it does not satisfy unchanged historical outcome gates. Both participant conditions require the same explicitly approved validation-target access and common data, with B alone receiving pinned author code. Structural masks are common or derivable, while observed test calcium remains private. With one biological cell and no bound enforcing transport or supported precommitted scientific policy, its verdict remains unqualified. Separate seven-field and full-36 obligations remain unchanged.
